purpose: Complete the bounded 2x2 reducer-by-detector audit before P0-S2B. Reconstruct P0-S2A exactly and change only its step reducer from max to the historical top-five mean while keeping the DUFS-LIU detector, family6 representation, rows, split, threshold objective, access and bootstrap fixed. Report both the adjacent S2I-vs-S2A edge and the S2I-vs-S0 same-reducer detector edge; treat S2A-vs-S0 only as a cumulative descriptive contrast. Compute the paired difference-in-differences interaction without promoting any method.

fixed_factors.evaluation_role: historical deterministic 20 percent audit per family
fixed_factors.answer_detector: calibration-only answer_dufs_liu_mixed; mixed-v2; k=7; lambda=0.1; seeds 11/23/37; 80 epochs
fixed_factors.threshold_objective: historical calibration-role ProcessBench macro F1 within each scorer cell
fixed_factors.threshold_tie_break: first maximum in stable descending risk sweep
fixed_factors.scorer_copy_grouping: same source-question draw carries both scorer copies and all four factorial states
fixed_factors.supervision: labels only for the unchanged threshold objective and evaluation metrics; detector and local representation fits remain label-free

contrast_contract.adjacent_attribution: S2I minus S2A changes only max to top5 under DUFS-LIU
contrast_contract.same_reducer_detector: S2I minus S0 changes only RegisteredGlobal to DUFS-LIU under top5
contrast_contract.cumulative_anchor: S2A minus S0 is pooling plus detector and is descriptive, never a detector-only effect
contrast_contract.interaction: (S2A-S1) - (S2I-S0), paired on the same source-question bootstrap draws
contrast_contract.interpretation: Adjacent contrasts support factor attribution; anchor contrasts report total displacement; neither audit contrast promotes a method.

bootstrap_contract: One common paired source-question bootstrap for all four factorial states. A family-unit draw carries both scorer copies and all four predictions; family estimates are averaged before the four-family macro effect and difference-in-differences interval.
hard_fail_conditions: any registered S0, S1 or S2A source, artifact, runner or registry hash differs
any S2A unit, target, locator, prediction, detector score, threshold or metric fails reconstruction within 1e-12
the 1270-row, 635-source-question population or grouping hash changes
any factor besides step_max_token_argmax to step_top5mean changes
the detector sees labels during fitting or its frozen mixed-v2 DUFS-LIU contract changes
the common-draw factorial bootstrap fails to reproduce the frozen S1 and S2A edge intervals within 1e-12
P0-S2B or any later bridge is opened in the same run
